correctness.rationale: The telegraph stationary transport equations yield beta(b,a) on [-1,1], with independent stationary Gaussian OU variance s. Gaussian strict variation-diminishing/heat zero-number implies at most three derivative zeros, two modes at small s and one at s>1; zeros cannot be created, yielding a unique loss event. The symmetric Kummer root has only strictly downward crossings, and at its critical tilted law E[Y²]=s_ell, E[Y^4]=(2ell+1)s_ell², so quartic coefficient K=2(ell-1)p0/s_ell²<0. Bias derivative B=-(2p0/s_ell)E[YatanhY]<0. The cusp fold solves (K/2)tau x+(K/6)x³+B eps=0 and derivative zero, giving x~A sgn(eps)|eps|^(1/3), s=s_ell-A²|eps|^(2/3)+o. Independent scipy hypergeometric/quadrature gives s_.5=.3164643403484472, A_.5=1.0116863053000347, agreeing with the package.
